user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update Task Description Successfully
steps: Navigate to the list of tasks.
Click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
Enter a new valid description in the description field.
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully and displays the new text.

negative.title: Attempt to Update Task Description Without Permission
steps: Log in as a user without edit permissions.
Navigate to the list of tasks.
Attempt to click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
negative.expected_result: The user is not able to edit the task description and receives a permission error message.

edge.title: Update Task Description with Maximum Character Length
steps: Navigate to the list of tasks.
Click on the 'Edit' button for the task.
Enter a description with the maximum allowed number of characters.
edge.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully and displays the entire maximum length text without any truncation.
